title: Efficacy and Safety of Fluvastatin in Children With Heterozygous Familial Hypercholesterolemia
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to assess the safety and efficacy of fluvastatin in children diagnosed with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 10-16 years old Heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia

Exclusion Criteria:

* Homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia Pregnant or lactating females Major surgery during the six month prior study

Other protocol defined inclusion and exclusion criteria may apply
